title: Debug request, parsed (the only thing the language model produces)
description: What the user asked for, in the user's own signal words. Names are resolved against the RTL afterwards by debug_core/rtl_index.py; nothing here is assumed to exist; names are checked against the RTL afterwards.

probes.description: signals to record, as named in the request (or the closest identifier from the signal list)

value.description: integer, or a string such as 0x41, 0b10x1 (x = don't care), 'A'

pre.description: cycles to keep before the trigger

post.description: cycles to keep after the trigger

clock.description: clock domain if the request names one

stimulus.description: register operations after arming (what makes the event happen)

readback.description: register reads after the capture, to compare with it

question.description: what the user wants to know from the capture, in one sentence

unclear.description: parts of the request the parser could not map
